pages.heading: Cold Sweat effect
pages.body: Pack default: -0.2 base temperature for 60 seconds. Cools while the effect lasts. The latest KNCraft thermal meal replaces the previous effect. Normal hunger rules apply. Server settings and tooltips take precedence.
